# Create payment requests for taxi fare from each roommate to Kathryn

taxi_share = 73 / 4  # 18.25
roommates = [
    ('Jordan Harrison', 'jo-harr@gmail.com'),
    ('Nancy Ritter', 'nan_ritt@gmail.com'),
    ('Troy Solomon', 'tr_solo@gmail.com')
]

for name, email in roommates:
    result = apis.venmo.create_payment_request(
        access_token=access_token,
        user_email=email,
        amount=taxi_share,
        description='Taxi Fare'
    )
    print(f"Taxi request to {name}: {result}")
